tasks.description: Add hostname, os_user columns and their indexes to bug_reports.
Add enabled column to user table.
Create update_releases table for API-managed software updates.
Create updater_clients and updater_events tables for EMLy Updater fleet stats.
Replace the exclusive channel ENUM with independent is_stable/is_beta flags on update_releases, so a release can be both stable and beta at once.
Create updater_releases table for the EMLy Updater self-update manifest.
Add product column to updater_events so EMLy client traffic and updater self-update traffic can be told apart.

Add hwid column to updater_clients so clients sending X-EMLy-HWID are identified by that instead of hostname/ad_domain, with the old hostname-based identification kept as a fallback for clients that don't send it yet.
Create remote_config_revisions table backing GET /v2/config and its admin routes.
Add config_revision/config_fetched_at columns to updater_clients so the fleet's remote-config rollout can be tracked without new telemetry rows.
Add a covering (product, event_type, created_at) index to updater_events so the /v2/stats/summary rollup stops full-scanning an index and looking up every candidate row.

Drop updater_events.idx_product_created, now redundant against the covering index from task 12, to cut write amplification on the insert-heavy event path. Runs after task 12 in file order, so the replacement index always exists first.
Add logged_user/serial/product columns to updater_clients so the X-EMLy-LoggedUser, X-EMLy-Serial and X-EMLy-Product headers the updater now sends are recorded against the client row.
Create the bans table backing the permanent IP/HWID/hostname blocks and their admin routes.
